name: StreamingAssetLoader
src_typeComment: Lazily loads Texture2D assets from StreamingAssets on demand instead of baking every image into the build/scene at once, evicting the least-recently-used entry once the cache exceeds maxCachedItems (via the plain-C# LruCache) — the direct answer to "too many assets" memory bloat on a kiosk with a large image library. Uses UnityWebRequestTexture rather than plain File I/O specifically because StreamingAssets lives inside a compressed APK/jar on Android and can't be read via System.IO there — this loader works identically across platforms.

src_serialized.name: maxCachedItems
src_serialized.tooltip: Maximum number of textures kept in memory at once. The least-recently-used one is unloaded when a new load would exceed this.

src_members.sig: public void Load(string relativePath, Action<Texture2D> onLoaded)
src_members.name: Load
src_members.comment: relativePath is relative to Application.streamingAssetsPath, e.g. "Kiosk/product-01.png".

src_members.name: UnloadAll
src_members.comment: Evicts everything immediately — e.g. right before switching to a completely different content set.
